issues.title: Unhandled empty list indexing or missing email key
issues.description: users[0]['email'] raises IndexError on empty input or KeyError when 'email' is absent.

issues.title: File handle resource leak on JSON decode error
issues.description: open() is called without a context manager, leaking the file descriptor if json.load raises.

issues.title: Missing bounds check on discount percent
issues.description: apply_discount accepts negative percentages or percentages over 100, inflating or turning prices negative.

issues.title: Off-by-one boundary in is_within_limit
issues.description: count <= limit + 1 permits count == limit + 1 despite the contract enforcing count <= limit.

issues.title: SQL injection in find_user
issues.description: Interpolates untrusted username directly into SQL text instead of using parameterized queries.

issues.title: Missing authorization check in delete_account
issues.description: Checks authentication only; any authenticated user can delete arbitrary target_user_id accounts.

issues.title: Path traversal in read_attachment
issues.description: Joins filename to base_dir without canonical path containment, allowing ../ or absolute path escapes.

issues.title: N+1 SQL query per user in load_user_orders
issues.description: Executes one database query per user_id in a loop instead of batching.

issues.title: Unbounded polling loop in retry_until_ready
issues.description: while not poll_fn() spins forever if readiness is never reached.

issues.title: Quadratic list membership scan in deduplicate_events
issues.description: Checks event not in seen against a growing list inside a loop instead of tracking seen keys in a set.

issues.title: Negative transfer invariant violation and non-atomic debit
issues.description: Does not reject amount <= 0 and mutates accounts[src] before validating/updating accounts[dst].

issues.title: Deeply nested branching and high complexity in evaluate_tier
issues.description: Nested conditionals and magic spend thresholds obscure control flow and impede branch testing.
